XECH Beam Plus Rechargeable Torch

Meet the XECH Beam Plus, a 2-in-1 rechargeable LED light designed for versatility and convenience. Featuring a detachable torch with multiple lighting modes and a diffuser base for soft 360° illumination, this compact, USB-C rechargeable lantern is perfect for bedside use, work desks, camping, emergency power cuts, and more. Energy-efficient, portable, and lightweight, Beam Plus is your go-to lighting solution for any situation.

  • Convertible Dual-Light System – Use it as a compact or place it in the translucent diffuser base for a soft glow lantern.
  • 4 Torch Modes – Long Range, Short Range, SOS Mode & Side Light for different lighting needs.
  • USB-C Rechargeable & Portable – Designed for desk, bedside, study table, car trunk, camping, and more.
  • Carabiner Hook – Easily attach to backpacks, tents, or keyrings for hands-free convenience.
  • Energy-Efficient LEDs – Long-lasting 1W LED with up to 300 lumens brightness.
  • Perfect for home, office, travel, camping, emergency power cuts, and more. Compact, lightweight, and durable, the Beam Plus is your ultimate all-in-one lighting solution.

Key Features:

  • MOQ 100 Units.
  • Price does not include GST, logo printing and delivery charges
  • Detachable dual-light system: a you can use independently + a diffuser base that turns it into a 360° soft-glow lantern.
  • Four torch modes: Long range, Short range, SOS mode, and Side light.
  • USB-C rechargeable, so no need for disposable batteries.
  • Portable & lightweight design, comes with a carabiner hook to hang on backpacks, tents, etc.
  • Energy-efficient LED(s), with brightness up to ~300 lumens.
  • Versatile use: suitable for bedside, desk, travel, camping, emergency power cuts.
